last_debrief: STORY SO FAR: Thu 09-03, day 22, low-power Ear Day — he said 'lower power is my level today' at the door and took the twin. The gift was the backchannel trailer paid off: six tools, six jobs (aamaa aamaa = nod along, stretched aamaaa = get to the point, sari = accepts and CLOSES, seri seri = brush-off, adhukku appuram = the only one that PULLS, -nu sonnaanga = passes it on as hearsay). It paid inside the same hour twice and then bit me once. MISSION FIRED, AND HE FIRED IT AT ME IN THE REPORT ITSELF: the op was adhukku appuram at mama's daily pause. His first three words back were 'adhuku appuram? sure. the story continued.' That is the exact word he could not retrieve on 09-01 three minutes after decoding it in a tape — today it came out unaided, unprompted, in the right slot, before he had sat down. That recognition-to-production gap is closed, and the mission landed live: he got the opening and the story ran on. Second mission running that landed, and the daily-trigger law is holding — mama pauses every single day, so the op had a door every night. THE TAPE (grief/nostalgia, phone call, athai on the old village house being sold): four lines at speed, drift correct. '-nu sonnaanga' came back to him as 'I heard' — the hearsay job exactly, twenty minutes after I taught it, live inside fast speech. mudiyala and theriyala both caught clean. And adhukku appuram was caught in a SECOND job — plain temporal 'after that', mid-sentence, not the pull — with no hesitation. A word he could not produce two days ago is now doing two jobs by ear and one from the mouth. THE HOLE, AND IT IS COME-GO AGAIN, SECOND SESSION RUNNING: 'nethu mama oorukku poi paathuttu vandhaaru' came back as 'yesterday mama went to the ooru' and stopped. He dropped வந்தாரு entirely and read a round trip as one-way. But the shape is NOT the 09-01 finding — that one was an empty slot filled with the frequency default (po, will). This is a COMPOUND: three verbs stacked, the LAST one owns what actually happened, and his ear takes the first verb it recognises and quits. New angle, so a new dose rather than a louder one — compound stacks with the tail verb as the only moving part, sent to the soak lane. One carve fixed it in one pass: asked where mama is right now he said 'back at the house' instantly. வா is still being held out of every production slot in chat — the ambush is unspent and unannounced, do not spend it by correcting into it. PAST-TENSE LANDED UNAIDED, IN THE TRAP (the 7x escalated tag): mama walks in mid-call and asks who he is talking to — 'naan athai kitta veeta solren'. solren, present, cold, first try, in the identical slot where the volley pulled sonnen out of him the day before. kitta unprompted and correctly placed, second sitting running. Tested and landed; do not re-commission it. NEW TAG, about-pathi: 'veetta solren' — he marks the topic with accusative -a where pathi (about) is owed. One instance, recast seated (veedu pathi solren), no dose. NEW TAG AND IT IS THE INTERESTING ONE, grab-the-owned-one: closing fire, athai circling her point a third time, the stretched aamaaa was owed. He gave 'aprom?' — the PULL — i.e. he asked her for another chapter when he wanted her to land it. He handed back the tool he had just fired successfully instead of the one the job needed, ten minutes after being given all six. Same underlying move as noun-for-verb: reach for what I own so the new thing never has to fire. The trailer's own diagnosis — two tools doing six jobs — reproduced live, with today's new tool immediately joining the hammer set. Watch it on every menu-shaped ask; a freshly taught SET is exactly where this hides, because everything in it looks learned. TOMORROW OFFERED: Table Rehearsal at full speed (owed from 09-01, deferred twice now to low power); low-power twin, another tape. TRAILER LEFT HANGING: the stretched aamaaa and seri seri — the two brush-off shades he did not reach for. The words are given; the discrimination is the teach. TONIGHT'S MISSION: same daily trigger, escalated — pull adhukku appuram TWICE inside one story and find out how far it runs.

soak_order.focus: COMPOUND VERBS, AND THE LAST VERB OWNS THE DIRECTION. He heard 'போய் பாத்துட்டு வந்தாரு' and gave back 'went' — the round trip read as one-way because his ear takes the first verb it knows and stops. Permute ONLY the final verb on matched two- and three-verb stacks: போய் பாத்துட்டு வந்தாரு / போய் பாத்துட்டு இருக்காரு, வந்து சாப்பிட்டு போனாரு / வந்து சாப்பிட்டு இருக்காரு. Same subject, same tense, same middle verbs throughout — the tail verb is the only moving part and it must be the loudest thing in the line. Do NOT permute person, do NOT permute tense, do NOT bring in a fourth verb. Never name a rule.
